prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving–outbound release. Elements/flows: Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay records proceed/rework/hold, governance-approval/change-controlled configuration. Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry→Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass: dimensions/profiles/Oversize Load Advisory (not placement authorization). Morrowglass→North Aisle Stacker Crane=Juniperwake: Slot Reservation Receipt; →Outbound Dispatch Sorter: Dispatch Wave Amendment; ←Juniperwake: Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; ←Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur: Forklift Handoff Confirmation, closing movement record. Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven→Larkspur: Transfer Induction Ticket. Maintenance Release Terminal=Copperfield→Juniperwake: Crane Service Release Card, return-to-service authorization after checks. Outbound Checkweigh Scale→Shipping Documentation Desk: Gross Weight Variance Slip, reconciled with shipment before paperwork; out-of-tolerance variance resolved before release. Trailer Seal Exception Note→Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook. Fire Alarm Panel→Safety Zone Controller: Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice. Other elements/actors: Inbound Pallet Buffer; South Aisle Stacker Crane; East Transfer Conveyor; West Transfer Conveyor; Warehouse Operations Supervisor; outgoing/incoming shifts; personnel; spotter. Requirements: receiving validation/damage-hold segregation; staging≠acceptance. Storage suitability/capacity/clearance/reservation/accessibility; retain scans/holds/blocked-reasons/locations. Cranes recheck availability/task/reservation/path; obstruction→stop; functional/safety checks before automated availability. Conveyors enforce routing/occupancy/readiness/spacing/merge-interlocks; duplicates/uncertainty→hold. Fleet validates vehicle/route/destination. Sorter follows committed plan; dimensional exceptions→review/hold; scale reference-checks shift-start/post-maintenance. Recovery: isolate discrepancies/alarms/obstructions; restrict feeding/vehicles/routes/buffer-access; safety controls stops. Reconcile records/sensors; plan envelope/stopping-point/stop-conditions; maintain boundary until understood/rechecked. South crane minimal reduced-speed, personnel-excluded/spotter-protected; uncertainty→stop/reassess. Supervisor verifies personnel-clear; staged observed restart. East conveyor empty reduced-speed full-cycle; record authorization/speed/result/alarm-response. Acceptance: approved pre-operation plan specifies behavior/safety/evidence/release-blockers; representative-load/interruption/stop-recovery tests; Morrowglass

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
